title: BMIC 2026 Day 3 Points Table: Korea Leads
description: BMIC 2026 Day 3 points table and standings: Korean teams lead, Team Outrage sit fifth, and two PMGC 2026 spots are decided on the final day in Mumbai.

body.text: The BGMI International Cup (BMIC) 2026 wraps up on November 1 with six matches still to play, according to Sportskeeda. Sixteen teams from India, South Korea and Japan are competing in Mumbai for two spots at the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026. After 12 matches, South Korean squads hold the top four places, and Indian fans will be watching to see whether anyone can break that run.

Sportskeeda reports that the final day will stream live on the Krafton India Esports YouTube channel from 12:30 pm IST. The broadcast will be available in several languages. The event has a total prize pool of ₹1 crore, roughly $105,000.
BMIC 2026 Day 3 points table and standings

NS RedForce lead the overall table with 128 points and three Chicken Dinners. Dplus are second with 105 points and three Chicken Dinners. Sportskeeda lists DRX third on 105 points and Game PT fourth on 88. Since DRX and Dplus appear on the same total, it is worth checking the official standings for exact placements.
Here is how the rest of the top ten looked after two days, per the report:

items: 5th: Team Outrage, led by Omega, with 83 points and one Chicken Dinner
9th: Team Soul, led by Nakul, with 72 points

body.text: Team Outrage are the highest-placed Indian side named in the report. At 83 points they sit five behind fourth-place Game PT, but 45 off the lead. Six games can swing a table, so a podium finish is still realistic if they land a big match. Team Soul, in ninth with 72 points, are 11 points behind Outrage.

Further down, REIGNITE are 11th with 67 points. Making The Road, FOCUS and Blitz follow with 50, 49 and 46 points. Valor are 15th on 38 points with one Chicken Dinner. Japan's Versus had a rough opening two days and are 16th with just 14 points.

Watch whether the Korean sides keep their grip on the leaderboard or whether the Indian squads in the middle of the table can push up with a few strong placements. Only two teams will earn PMGC 2026 berths, so every Chicken Dinner and elimination matters in the last six games. Streaming begins at 12:30 pm IST on November 1.
